instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text: Choose the correct answer of the following (Any seven question only):

sub_questions.text: Sieving is not practicable for grain sizes smaller than about
The flow index in soils indicates the
options: (i) ratio of liquid limit to plastic limit
(iv) shear strength variation and water content

sub_questions.text: A flow line in seepage through a soil medium is defined as the
options: (i) path of particles of water through a saturated soil mass
(ii) line connecting points of equal head of water
(iii) flow of movement of fine particles of soil

sub_questions.text: The effective stress on the soil is due to the
options: (i) external load acting on the soil
(iii) weight of water present in the soil pores

sub_questions.text: By means of Boussinesq's stress distribution theory, which one of the following pressure distribution diagrams can be prepared?
options: (ii) Vertical pressure distribution on a horizontal plane
(iii) Vertical pressure distribution on an inclined plane
(iv) Pressure distribution diagram on an oblique plane

sub_questions.text: A soil sample has a porosity of $40$ percent. The specific gravity of solids is $2.70$. What is void ratio?
A line showing the dry density as a function of water content for soil containing no air voids, is called
The critical gradient of a soil increases
Consistency is term used to indicate
options: (ii) the degree of firmness of cohesive soils

sub_questions.text: Which one of the following does not affect the permeability of soils?

questions.text: The soil profile in a particular site consists of $7\text{ m}$ thick sandy layer overlain by a layer of clay. The water table is at $1\text{ m}$ below the ground surface. Above the water table, the sand is saturated with capillary moisture. The dry unit weight of sand is $17\text{ kN/m}^3$ and its saturated unit weight is $20\text{ kN/m}^3$. Plot the total stress, neutral stress and effective stress with depth up to a depth of $7\text{ m}$.

An embankment is to be constructed using sandy clay compacted to dry unit weight of $18\text{ kN/m}^3$. The sandy clay has to be transported to the site from a borrow pit. The bulk unit weight of the sandy clay in the borrow pit is $16\text{ kN/m}^3$ and its natural water content is $11\%$. Calculate the volume of sandy clay from the borrow pit required for $1$ cubic metre of finished embankment. Assume that the soil swells by $10\%$ due to excavation and during transportation. You can take $G_s = 2.7$.

sub_questions.text: A $1.2\text{ m}$ thick embankment of loose sand is to be compacted using a Vibratory Roller. If the void ratio decreases from $1.2$ to $0.8$ due to compaction, calculate the final thickness of the embankment.
What is the effect of surcharge and the capillary action on the effective stress? Explain briefly.

Two columns A and B are situated $6\text{ m}$ apart. Column A transfers a load of $500\text{ kN}$ and column B, a load of $250\text{ kN}$. Determine the resultant vertical stress on horizontal plane $20\text{ m}$ below the ground surface at points vertically below the points A and B.
Derive an expression for bulk density in terms of its water content, void ratio, specific gravity of solids and density of water.
A sample of clay has a void ratio of $0.70$ in the undisturbed state and of $0.50$ in a remoulded state. If the specific gravity of solids is $2.65$, determine the shrinkage limit in each case.
What is the difference between the classification based on particle size and textural classification? Discuss the limitations of the two systems.
Distinguish between discharge velocity and seepage velocity in the case of flow of water through soils.

A soil sample $40\text{ mm}$ high and $6000\text{ mm}^2$ in cross-section was subjected to a falling head permeability test. The head fell from $500$ to $300\text{ mm}$ in $1500$ seconds. The permeability of the soil was $2.4 \times 10^{-3}\text{ mm/s}$. determine the diameter of the standpipe.
What are the different methods of compaction adopted in the field? How would you select the type of roller to be used?

Atterberg limit tests were carried out on a soil sample, with the results LL as $40\%$ and PL as $25\%$. Classify the soil according to Unified Classification system and the Indian standard classification system.
